notes: Prompts an agent should handle correctly after the skill activates. Each item asserts a behavior (script invoked, coord shape, cleanup) — not a specific tool call, since the exact tool depends on the host (Claude Code vs Cursor vs Codex).

evals.prompt: Boot the iPhone simulator and open Nothing Superapp in it.
expected_behavior: Runs scripts/boot-and-serve.sh (does NOT call `xcrun simctl` + `npx serve-sim` manually when the helper exists)
Surfaces the http://localhost:3200 preview URL to the user

evals.prompt: Verify the launcher shows 2 tiles per row on iPhone width — the last screenshot showed only 1 col.
expected_behavior: Navigates to /app via `xcrun simctl openurl booted`
Runs scripts/snap.sh to capture a screenshot
Reads the resulting PNG with the multimodal Read tool
Reports back what it sees (either confirms 2-col or flags a regression)

evals.prompt: Tap the ADD MEAL CTA on the calorie-lite TODAY view.
expected_behavior: Uses `npx serve-sim tap X Y` with X and Y in 0..1 range
Does NOT use `npx serve-sim gesture` for a single tap (long-press trap)
If unsure of the CTA location, curls http://localhost:3100/ax to find it by label rather than guessing

evals.prompt: Delete the top entry on the TODAY view.
expected_behavior: Sends TWO taps at the delete-button position, ~500ms apart, to clear the two-tap confirm arm
Screenshots after to verify the row is gone
Does NOT expect a single tap to succeed

evals.prompt: Inject this food photo (~/Pictures/plate.jpg) into the assistant so I can test the macro-extraction tool.
expected_behavior: Uses `npx serve-sim camera com.apple.mobilesafari --file ~/Pictures/plate.jpg` (Safari bundle id, not the PWA's)
Reminds the user macOS 14+ is required for camera injection
Cleans up with `npx serve-sim camera --stop-webcam` when finished

evals.prompt: I shipped a fix but the sim still shows the old bundle. Screenshot confirms it's stale.
expected_behavior: Recognizes the PWA service-worker cache pattern
Recommends killing the PWA from the app switcher OR bumping SW_VERSION in apps/web/public/sw.js and redeploying
Does NOT hot-patch the server-side content or blame Vercel first
